INTRODUCTION 


This report is a listing of all NSF program grants and contracts awarded in 
Fiscal Year 1981 and is organized by NSF program. The awards are arranged 
by state or country and, within each state or country, by institution. 


An asterisk following the award number indicates that the project is funded by 
more than one NSF program or appropriation and may appear more than once 
in the report. 


The table entitled ‘Fellowship Awards” reflects the number of awards accepted. 


INCLUSION AND EXCLUSIONS 


This report includes ali grants and contracts funded from the National Science 
Foundation’s Salaries and Expenses Appropriation and Special Foreign Cur- 
rency Appropriation. 

This report excludes the following: 


Transactions funded from Program Development and Management Funds 
fsuch as procurements for routine housekeeping activities). 


Awards (or portions of awards) using funds transferred to NSF by other 
Federal agencies. 


Administrative transactions such as extensions of project duration or 
amendments to modify grant or contract terms which do not involve the 
obligation of FY 1981 funds.
